question: Who of the following received Sangeet Natak Akademi Award for his contribution to Sattriya dance?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Tankeswar Hazarika Borbavan**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Tankeswar Hazarika Borbayan received **the Sangeet Natak Akademi Award for his contribution to Sattriya dance.
 
• **The Sangeet Natak Akademi is India's national academy for music, dance, and drama.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **It recognizes outstanding artists in these fields. **

 
 
• **Radha Sridhar: **Received the award for her contribution to Bharatnatyam
 
• **Akham Lakshmi Devi:** Received the award for her contribution to Manipuri
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Ishira and Maulik Shah**: Received a joint award for their contribution to Kathak
 
• **Akham Lakshmi Devi: **Received the award for her contribution to Manipuri
 
• **Pasumurthy Ramalinga Sastry:** Received the award for his contribution to Kuchipudi
 
• **Surupa Sen:** Received the award for her contribution to Odissi
 
• **Gopika Varma: **Received the award for her contribution to Mohiniattam
